section_summary.extract_value: This section reports confirmatory factor analysis results for BAS-2 in a 'second subsample', noting an initially unacceptable one-factor model fit which improved after adding specified error covariances. Reliability was excellent (Cronbach's alpha = .94 overall; .95 for men, .93 for women) and factor loadings ranged from .61 to .88.
section_summary.evidence_source: The one-factor structure of BAS-2 scores in the second subsample had unacceptable model fit: -2(35) = 184.993, p < .001, -2 normed = 5.286, CFI = .947, RMSEA= .106 with 90% CI = .091 – .121, SRMR = .038. Next, the error covariances between Items 1 and 5, Items 2 and 9, and Items 8 and 10 were added. The fit indices values were acceptable: -2(32) = 106.232, p < .001, -2 normed = 3.320, CFI = .974, RMSEA= .078 with 90% CI = .062 – .094, SRMR = .026. Factor loadings for all items ranged from .61 to .88 (see Supplementary materials). Cronbach's alpha was .94 (.95 for men and .93 for women) and item-total correlations ranged from .62 to .85.
